answer: Proof of Work provides robust Sybil resistance by tying identity to computational expenditure. Unlike a simple sonnet of digital signatures, this mechanism forces agents to solve cryptographic puzzles, creating an artificial scarcity akin to traversing a steep knoll or complex karst terrain. The cost for an attacker is the direct energy and hardware capital required to outpace honest nodes; generating fake identities without verifiable processing power becomes economically ruinous and physically impossible to scale.
